description: power-law spine A*pick^-B (WLS of log(per-pick mean) on log(pick), the 265 zero-value rows kept at full weight inside those means so the log of a zero is never taken) fitted on the SUB-RANGE picks 8-64 with BREAK POINT = 8 (first pick where the shipped bandwidth policy sits on its floor) and held FLAT at spine(8) below the break rather than extrapolated, plus additive residuals smoothed with the shipped bandwidth policy — RESIDUAL BANDWIDTH h(p) in log(pick) units, grown from hmin=0.10 in 0.02 steps until nmin=35 effective rows, capped hmax=0.60, realised as h=0.60/0.36/0.26/0.20/0.16/0.14/0.12 at picks 1-7 and h=0.10 at every pick 8-64 — then recombined, clipped at 0 and forced monotone non-increasing (PAVA on effective-n weights, then a 1.0-unit strict descent over plateaus) before the harness's pin; alpha=1, no CE aggregator

diagnostics.residual_bandwidth_policy: H.bandwidth_at: hmin=0.10 -> hmax=0.60 in 0.02 steps until effective n >= 35
diagnostics.zero_row_handling: 265-style zero-value rows retained at full weight inside the per-pick arithmetic means; log is taken of the mean, never of a row
